findings.title: Exact rollback inventory omits the actual three CHECK definitions
findings.cause: The inventory checks the three CHECK constraints by name/type and validated/nondeferrable flags. Its following exact key/reference loop covers only PK/UNIQUE/FK constraints. Neither conbin, pg_get_constraintdef nor another expected definition comparison binds the CHECK expressions.
findings.concreteCounterexample: On an otherwise empty valid owned fixture, replace heads_v1_shape with a validated same-name CHECK(true). The checked name/type/flags and all PK/UNIQUE/FK fields remain unchanged, so the current inventory cannot distinguish that altered metadata and rollback may drop it. This contradicts the accepted exact expected-constraints/altered-metadata refusal contract.
findings.boundedRequiredCorrection: Validate deterministic exact definitions of revisions_v1_shape, heads_v1_shape and operations_v1_shape in the finite inventory shared by installation and rollback; no broader architecture, new live privilege or source authority.
findings.requiredEvidence: One actual mandatory native same-name changed-CHECK case must refuse rollback and fresh readback must preserve the changed definition and all candidate objects. The pristine positive rollback must still succeed.
findings.notification: Sent to Root and original writer; writer explicitly acknowledged the missing CHECK-body comparison and accepted same-session correction. This reviewer did not edit author files or issue an expanded task.

reviewedSourceObservations.area: Closed scalar command and timestamp parsing
reviewedSourceObservations.assessment: No additional concrete defect found in this early source read. Null/unused fields, operation IDs, exact method/digest tuple, predecessor, expected head and approval modes are validated before state checks. Time syntax/civil round-trip is separate from future-expiry decisions.

reviewedSourceObservations.area: History before NEW-state checks and actor custody
reviewedSourceObservations.assessment: Mutators reuse confirm in the same transaction. Exact command+fresh actor returns historical record before CAS/predecessor/future expiry/exhaustion; absent confirm writes no history. Actor is derived after the unchanged helper, and stored history is not a current-authority receipt.

Operation advisory mutex precedes method mutex; three table locks, current head FOR UPDATE and selected/predecessor/expected revision FOR SHARE precede the exact helper. The helper uses own user/session/profile SHARE NOWAIT and post-lock actual clock. No new Auth grants, statement-Boolean substitute or catch-and-allow appeared.

reviewedSourceObservations.area: States, immutable revisions and terminal epoch
reviewedSourceObservations.assessment: Stage leaves current authority untouched. Approval requires registered revision1 on absence or same/immediate next revision under exact CAS. Approval/reapproval cannot produce epoch2147483647; terminal revoke can. Operation history append and state transition remain in one transaction. The original predecessor-NULL table-check gap was tightened by the author in the reviewed delta; no unresolved API path was found.

reviewedSourceObservations.area: Machine observation and private locked check
reviewedSourceObservations.assessment: Read_current locks head FOR SHARE and samples clock afterward, distinguishes fixed negative states and floors full-precision remaining time against greatest(DB time, caller time). Owner-only final checker locks then uses actual DB time and exact tuple/epoch. Source comments correctly keep later joint-publication waits/reproof out of this preliminary read authority claim.

Creator grants are inspected before ownership transfer/normalization. Machine gets only API usage and read-current execute; human role gets only four human entrypoints; private functions/tables have no external grants. Final checks include inherited effective privileges, role attributes/membership and direct column ACLs. Actual native installation remains unexecuted.

reviewedSourceObservations.area: Rollback order, emptiness, rights and scope
reviewedSourceObservations.assessment: Owned local fixture guards precede three ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks and post-all-wait emptiness. Exact role/membership/ACL checks precede finite RESTRICT drops; unknown rights are not normalized. The identified CHECK-definition omission remains the specific metadata gap. Foreign dependency failure restores transaction. No #1142/default-role/Auth deletion is included.
